name: update-read-order
source: set command dict; set events {}; set reads 0; set d {k OLD}; proc watch {a b op} {lappend ::events $op}; trace add variable d read watch; set code [catch {$command update d k v {set v NEW}} result]; trace remove variable d read watch; list $code $result $events $d

name: update-full-order
source: set command dict; set events {}; set reads 0; set d {k OLD}; proc watch {a b op} {lappend ::events $op}; trace add variable d {read write} watch; trace add variable v {read write} watch; set code [catch {$command update d k v {set v NEW}} result]; trace remove variable d {read write} watch; trace remove variable v {read write} watch; list $code $result $events $d

name: update-root-replacement
source: set command dict; set events {}; set reads 0; set d {k OLD}; proc watch {a b op} {lappend ::events $op; incr ::reads; if {$::reads == 2} {set ::d {fresh KEPT}}}; trace add variable d read watch; set code [catch {$command update d k v {set v NEW}} result]; trace remove variable d read watch; list $code $result $events $d
